connections.why: Stokes showed the substance of the red cells takes up oxygen and gives it back; Perutz showed its shape changing as it does.

Hoppe-Seyler and Stokes read blood with the slit and prism that Kirchhoff and Bunsen had made a spectroscope in 1859, and Stokes placed hemoglobin's absorption bands against Fraunhofer's lines D, E, b and F.
